name: soy
title: Start-of-year (SOY) budgets
description: The recommended future state of SOY: a cycle overview with next actions by role, a setup wizard, an items workspace with a side panel, final decisions, transfers with reconciliation, close-out, and activity.

fields.item: project number + fund + account type (Expense) within one fiscal year’s SOY — the Gemini identity
fields.amounts: whole dollars, recorded per stage (ewb, pm, final), each with who, when and a rationale
fields.transfers: per item, tied to a Budget Decision (one per round); variance = final − transferred
fields.today: the demo date moves with the walkthrough (Jan 15 → Jun 15, 2027)

notes: Screens: /soy (overview), /soy/cycles, /soy/setup, /soy/items (+ item side panel on every screen), /soy/finals, /soy/transfers, /soy/close-out, /soy/activity.
State changes are plain functions in src/lib/soy/actions.ts; the store wraps each in persist + notify (event cbf-soy:change). Bulk actions return a report of written and skipped items.

Demo presets (?step=1…7, plus 4.5 for the PM landing; linked from the separate walkthrough guide, not from the prototype) compose the same actions; src/lib/soy/soy.test.ts pins their numbers (npm test).
Every behavior change is tagged UI / BE / DEC in src/lib/soy/changes.ts and annotated in place by the “Show what’s changing” layer (cbf-soy-changes).
All people and comment text are invented; project numbers and titles are illustrative.

sections.label: Draft notice
sections.html:
Draft
The FY2028 SOY was drafted automatically on Jan 15, 2027 with the standard dates. Review the dates and run setup to carry items forward and open it. Start setup

guide.intent: On Jan 15 the next cycle drafts itself with the standard dates; the overview says so and points the budget administrator to setup. PMs see when their input opens.
decisions: DEC 6: auto-draft each year on January 15; the admin reviews and opens it.
acceptance: With fresh storage the overview shows FY2028 as Draft with a Start setup link (admin).

sections.label: Stage tracker
sections.html:
1. 1 EWB proposed Opens Mar 1 · due Apr 11 Upcoming
  2. 2 PM proposed Opens Apr 12 · due May 9 Upcoming

guide.intent: The four stages with open and due dates, the active stage and days left. A stage is due the day before the next one opens. "Open <next stage>" (admin) previews the stage-open email before it advances; stages never advance on their own.
decisions: DEC 5: due dates drive stage-open emails and automatic reminders; the admin still advances stages; PM proposed defaults to 4 weeks.
Final budget → Complete has no advance button here; the cycle completes through Close-out.
acceptance: Default dates: EWB proposed opens Mar 1, PM proposed Apr 12 (due May 9), Final budget May 10, Complete Jun 1.

guide.intent: Items in cycle, EWB proposed, PM input received vs needed, final amount set, transferred and variance (final − transferred), always current. PMs see their own tiles instead.
gotchas: PM input needed excludes two-year items in their off year (their $0 is automatic).
acceptance: At ?step=5 (May 7): 219 of 231 PM inputs received, 4 PMs with 12 items outstanding.

sections.html:

    Start setup →

guide.intent: What the budget administrator should do next for the current stage, each with the button that does it: run setup, set EWB proposed, open the next stage, send a reminder, set finals, transfer, reconcile, close.
acceptance: Every action links to the screen or opens the dialog that completes it.
